unit.title: Work and family
canDo: Ask and say what someone does

example.en: My mum works at a university.

vocabulary.usageNote: 和 joins nouns only. To join sentences, just use a comma, or 也.

example.zh: 很累，可是我喜欢我的工作。
example.py: Hěn lèi, kěshì wǒ xǐhuan wǒ de gōngzuò.
example.en: It's tiring, but I like my job.

vocabulary.usageNote: Surname + 先生 for a man you don't know well. 您 is the polite "you".

grammar.explanation: The place comes before the action, introduced by 在: 我在医院工作 (I at hospital work). English puts the place at the end; Chinese never does here. Ask with 在哪儿: 你在哪儿工作？

examples.en: My mum works at a university.

commonMistakes.why: 在 + place comes before the verb.

grammar.pattern: A 和 B + 都 + verb
grammar.purpose: Say both or all of them do something
grammar.explanation: 都 goes after the people it covers and before the verb: 爸爸和妈妈都是老师. It always looks back at a plural subject. 和 joins nouns only.

examples.zh: 我爸爸和妈妈都是老师。
examples.py: Wǒ bàba hé māma dōu shì lǎoshī.
examples.en: My dad and mum are both teachers.
They both work at the hospital.

commonMistakes.why: 都 comes after the subject, before the verb.

dialogue.title: Over dinner
dialogue.setting: Anna and Chen Yu chat over dinner.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.py: Chén Yǔ, nǐ zuò shénme gōngzuò?
lines.en: Chen Yu, what do you do?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 我是医生，在医院工作。你呢？
lines.py: Wǒ shì yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Nǐ ne?
lines.en: I'm a doctor, at a hospital. You?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 我是大学生。我爸爸妈妈都是老师。
lines.py: Wǒ shì dàxuéshēng. Wǒ bàba māma dōu shì lǎoshī.
lines.en: I'm a student. My parents are both teachers.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 在美国的一个学校。你的工作累吗？
lines.py: Zài Měiguó de yí ge xuéxiào. Nǐ de gōngzuò lèi ma?
lines.en: At a school in the US. Is your job tiring?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 很累，可是我喜欢我的工作。
lines.py: Hěn lèi, kěshì wǒ xǐhuan wǒ de gōngzuò.

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.py: Duì, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng.

choices: One teaches, one is a doctor

questions.q: How does Chen Yu feel about his job?

reading.title: Chen Yu's family photo
reading.blurb: Chen Yu posts a family photo.
reading.purpose: Chen Yu posted a family photo. Read to find out what everyone does, and when they get together.

lines.zh: 这是我的家：爸爸、妈妈和我。
lines.py: Zhè shì wǒ de jiā: bàba, māma hé wǒ.
lines.en: This is my family: Dad, Mum and me.

lines.zh: 我爸爸是医生，在医院工作。
lines.py: Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
lines.en: My dad is a doctor at a hospital.

lines.zh: 我妈妈在大学工作，她是老师。
lines.py: Wǒ māma zài dàxué gōngzuò, tā shì lǎoshī.
lines.en: My mum works at a university; she's a teacher.

lines.zh: 我也是医生！我们都很忙。
lines.py: Wǒ yě shì yīshēng! Wǒmen dōu hěn máng.
lines.en: I'm a doctor too! We're all busy.

lines.zh: 星期天我们一起在家吃饭。
lines.py: Xīngqītiān wǒmen yìqǐ zài jiā chīfàn.
lines.en: On Sundays we eat together at home.

questions.q: Why is Sunday special for them?
choices: It's when the busy family eats together
questions.answer: It's when the busy family eats together

lines.py: Wǒ māma zài dàxué gōngzuò, tā shì lǎoshī.
lines.en: My mum works at a university; she's a teacher.

lines.py: Wǒ yě shì yīshēng! Wǒmen dōu hěn máng.

conversation.title: What do you do?
conversation.context: Someone you just met asks about your work.
conversation.goal: Say what you do, where, and how it is

turns.intent: Say your job or that you're a student

conversation.aiPartnerBrief: You are 陈宇, a doctor at a dinner party. Ask about work and family using HSK 1 words.

pragmatics.situation: Asking a new acquaintance about work
pragmatics.note: Older people in China may ask about pay; many younger people find it too personal with someone new.

pragmatics.situation: Greeting an older man you don't know well
pragmatics.note: Surname + 先生 and 您 show respect. 喂 is for the phone, not for people in front of you.

tasks.statement: The speaker works at a school.
tasks.why: 医院 is a hospital; a school is 学校.

audio.zh: 我爸爸和妈妈都是老师。
audio.py: Wǒ bàba hé māma dōu shì lǎoshī.
audio.en: My dad and mum are both teachers.

audio.zh: 我不是医生，我是大学生。
audio.py: Wǒ bú shì yīshēng, wǒ shì dàxuéshēng.
audio.en: I'm not a doctor; I'm a university student.

tasks.why: 不是医生 means not a doctor.

lines.zh: 陈宇是【医生】。他在医院【工作】，每天都很【累】。
lines.py: Chén Yǔ shì yīshēng. Tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, měi tiān dōu hěn lèi.
lines.en: Chen Yu is a doctor. He works at a hospital and is tired every day.
